verdict.rationale: Zoho CRM documents custom modules for business-specific data (docs-35). Its Modules API covers standard, subform, linking (MxN) and custom modules (docs-11), and metadata APIs expose fields, layouts and related lists (docs-9), so custom objects with fields and relationships are first-party capabilities that COQL can query (docs-23, docs-5). missing for 10: explicit docs on defining custom fields and lookup or relationship fields programmatically, depth on relationship types and limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.
